title: Legacy OAuth tokens stored in UserDefaults - security vulnerability
description: The legacy app stores Fitbit OAuth user tokens (fitbitAuthCode and fitbitSecret) in NSUserDefaults via PersistenceDefaults.m. UserDefaults is not secure storage - data can be extracted from device backups and is not encrypted. Must migrate existing users to Keychain storage using CredentialsBootstrap.migrateFromLegacyStorage() during app upgrade.
close_reason: Implemented secure OAuth token migration from UserDefaults to Keychain. Created OAuthTokenMigration.swift (migration service), updated CredentialsBootstrap.swift, and added comprehensive tests. Follow-up ticket JogPod-revived-bu5 created for app launch integration.

Consider migrating to OAuth 2.0 which is simpler, more secure, and uses PKCE for mobile apps. This would eliminate the need to store consumer secret client-side.
close_reason: Already completed - OAuthService uses ASWebAuthenticationSession with OAuth 2.0 (see 7u0, ajq)
